name: Wrike
description: Wrike is an AI-powered work management platform that gives enterprises visibility into projects, resources, and workflows across teams and departments.
best_for: Marketing, product, operations, and PMO teams at mid-size to large enterprises coordinating complex, cross-functional work.
features: Interactive Gantt charts for timeline planning
Custom request forms for work intake

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Essential task management, unlimited users. Web, desktop and mobile apps, board and table views.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.notes: Per user/month, billed annually. Restricted to 2-15 users. AI Essentials, Gantt charts.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Per user/month, billed annually. Restricted to 5-200 users. Most popular tier. AI Elite starter pack, workspace templates.

tiers.name: Pinnacle
tiers.notes: Contact sales. For 5+ users. Advanced resource/capacity planning, budgeting, advanced reporting.

tiers.name: Apex
tiers.notes: Contact sales. Unlimited whiteboards, Wrike Integrate and Wrike Sync included.

cons: Team and Business tiers have hard user-count ranges (Team: 2-15, Business: 5-200) rather than open per-seat pricing -- outgrowing the range means moving up a full tier, not just adding seats.
Annual billing is required from Business tier upward, per the vendor's own pricing page.

alternatives.name: Monday.com
alternatives.description: A work operating system with customizable boards for managing projects and workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a highly visual, customizable workflow builder

alternatives.name: Smartsheet
alternatives.description: A spreadsheet-style work management platform with Gantt charts, automation, and enterprise reporting.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprise PMOs needing spreadsheet-familiar project controls

alternatives.name: ClickUp
alternatives.description: A project-management platform with tasks, dashboards, documents, and workflow automation.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that need structured project management

alternatives.name: Zoho Projects
alternatives.description: An online project management platform for planning, tracking, and collaborating on work, with deep integration into the wider Zoho suite.
alternatives.best_for: Teams already using Zoho apps, or organizations wanting an affordable, feature-rich project tool bundled with invoicing and billing
